title: Drop the dead plugin-wheel steps from the verification workflow
summary: The verification workflow still builds and installs assayer_plugin_frontend_audit-*.whl, but b5921f9 reduced scripts/build_distributions.py so DISTRIBUTIONS contains only assayer-plugin-sdk, assayer-agent, and assayer-platform; ordinary plugins are data-only and are not Python distributions, so that wheel is never produced. The workflow's fast and full jobs therefore fail at the pip install step. The build step's output /tmp/assayer-wheels has no other consumer once that install line is removed, and split-distribution building is the install-matrix job's documented responsibility, so the dead build step is removed as well. No Python version, test, or install reference changes. Verification evidence: this change landed in 64ba888, the commit that added this record and the only historical landing in this group with a green run; CI run 35194423679 on that head commit passed all seven jobs (Fast on Python 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13, Full on 3.11 and 3.13, and Install matrix on 3.11 and 3.13), and the change remains in force at 66e7e45.

platform: Release engineering owns the verification workflow and its gate definitions
plugin: No plugin change; ordinary plugins remain data-only

forbiddenResponsibilities: The change must not remove any referenced artifact that still exists
The change must not alter the CI matrix Python versions or the gate definitions in docs/ci-support-matrix-v1.md
Split-distribution build coverage must remain owned by the install-matrix job and the unit tests
acceptance: the fast and full jobs no longer reference assayer_plugin_frontend_audit or /tmp/assayer-wheels
no step in .github/workflows/verification.yml references a build output that no later step consumes
the CI matrix Python versions are unchanged and still agree with docs/ci-support-matrix-v1.md
the workflow parses as valid YAML and scripts/run_tests.py fast and full stay green
split-distribution building remains covered by the install-matrix job and tests/test_install_matrix.py

humanApproval.decision: User replied '同意。' in #assayer-group:4c84ee19, approving the proposed workflow fix (delete the dead plugin-wheel build step and install line) and the plan to create this record, commit, and push.
